segments.text: Night on campus. The porter has locked the hostel. Stay out of the torch beams, take the guards down from behind, and be out of the back gate before dawn.
Baba Ticket wants his share by evening. Collect from every bus that stops on your side. Stand in front of the ones that try to run.
The driver is running with the fee. Follow the red marker, mind the people on the pavement, and grab the door.
In and out, no noise. The stash is on the altar. Nobody sees you, nobody touches you, and the respect is yours.
The bet closes in three minutes. Three drop points across Wuse. Hit them all before the pool is cleared.
They are at the gate. Grab the hard drive, the laptop and the cash, and get out through the back. Do not knock anything over.
E F C C! Nobody move! Everybody on the floor!
Police! Stop there! Hands where we can see them!
Task Force! Clear this road now now!
Wahala dey o! They are coming. Run!
Somebody don talk. They know where you are.
Ayeee! Who we be? We no dey fear! Who we be? We no dey fear!
This street na our own! Comot! Comot for here!
Na we get this place! Na we get am!
Hey! Who is that? Stop there!
Where did he go? Check behind the containers.
Ah! Who did this? Wake up!
This is Baba Radio, ninety-nine point nine. Traffic on the bridge is heavy, fuel is scarce, and somebody's son don collect another loan.
Baba Radio. Voting has closed. The results are being counted, and everybody is already celebrating.
Baba Radio sports desk. The pool is open. Place your bets, and may your village people not see you.
Breaking news. Operatives have stormed an estate in Lekki. Neighbours say they heard the gate, then they heard the generator stop.
Oshodi! Oshodi! Enter with your change! Two chance remain!
Original phone, original price! Come and check, no be by force!
Our man! Our man! Vote for continuity, vote for your stomach!
Attention all students. The examination begins in ten minutes. Phones, notes and expo are not allowed in the hall.
